ModMetaData.name: ColonyOS
ModMetaData.author: ArliT1-F
ModMetaData.description:
Your colony. Your data. Your decisions.
A colony intelligence dashboard with persistent history, seven connected departments, evidence-based forecasts, and regional purchasing analysis. ColonyOS observes and recommends; it never changes work priorities, bills, storage, or trade decisions for you.
Requires Harmony. No DLC or external UI framework is required.
